title: Neon Oni Snow Globe
description: A glowing neon Oni demon face with yellow horns and sharp teeth is encased inside a transparent crystal ball. The orb sits on a black mechanical base atop a wooden table, dripping vibrant neon slime in green, pink, and purple that flows down onto the surface.
prompt: A glowing neon yellow and pink Japanese Oni demon mask with horns and sharp teeth floats inside a transparent crystal ball, surrounded by floating bubbles and electric energy. The orb rests on a black mechanical base on a dark wooden table. Bright green, pink, and purple neon slime drips heavily from the globe onto the table surface. Dark background with dramatic lighting, surreal and vibrant aesthetic.
